title: Hot-Cold Tiering of HBM and High Bandwidth Flash for Agentic LLM Serving
summary: Large language model (LLM) serving is increasingly agentic, with multi-turn sessions that idle between actions yet must retain their full context. Limited GPU memory capacity forces inactive KV states to be evicted, so resuming a session incurs either costly recomputation or slow interconnect transfers.
